description: Evaluation prompts for the landing-page-design skill. Run these with and without the skill loaded and compare outputs. The skill should produce domain-appropriate, coherent sites — not generic AI-slop.
judging_criteria: Domain reasoning is visible — section choices, aesthetic, CTAs match the domain recipe
Design tokens (colors, fonts, radius, shadow, motion) are defined before any component is installed
Components come from at least 2 real registries (shadcn + one of Magic UI / Aceternity / Kibo UI / Launch UI / Skiper)
No hardcoded hex colors, arbitrary radii, or inline font-family in the final page code
Critical CTA for the domain appears above the fold and repeats at the bottom
llms.txt is generated at project root and correctly describes the site
Agent did not implement SEO (meta, schema, sitemap) — that's a handoff

prompts.prompt: Build a landing page for a dermatologist practice in Dubai. Two doctors, focus is on cosmetic dermatology and laser treatments. They want patients to book consultations.
prompts.expected_aesthetic: calm, warm, clinical-but-human — muted blue/teal/sage, warm off-black, serif display
must_not: stock smiling team photo without flagging it as placeholder

prompts.prompt: I need a site for my indie SaaS launch. It's a focus-mode app for developers that blocks distractions and tracks deep work sessions. Going live next week.
prompts.expected_aesthetic: clean, confident, technical — dark mode optional, Geist or Inter Display, medium motion

prompts.prompt: I'm starting a boutique design studio in Lisbon, 3 people, focus on brand identity and type-driven work. Need a site that screams taste.
prompts.expected_critical_cta: start a project / book a call
prompts.expected_aesthetic: editorial, confident, monochromatic with one accent, editorial serif or bold sans, high taste, one signature motion
must_not: generic SaaS bento grid for work showcase

prompts.prompt: Making a site for a new neighborhood restaurant — Italian, chef-driven, small, takes reservations.
prompts.expected_aesthetic: photography-led, atmospheric, warm palette (cream / oxblood / deep green), characterful serif display, low motion
must_include: flagging Unsplash as placeholder if food photography isn't provided

prompts.prompt: Landing page for a new DeFi lending protocol launching on Base. Audited, TVL tracking, connect wallet flow.
prompts.expected_aesthetic: dark mode default, neon accents, technical sans (Geist / JetBrains Mono), high motion — meteors / globe / animated beams are on-brand
